objective:
stop requiring me to manually test Agentic OS. Continue the current AntiGravity engineering task and build an autonomous production capability-certification and self-healing runner. Do not create parallel AntiGravity repair tasks.
The runner must inventory and test every currently supported AgenticOS capability sequentially through the SAME installed production paths used by my real Jarvis voice/text requests. Do not substitute campaign scripts, direct service calls, helper scripts, or mocked/API-only tests for the real production route. Internal scripts may collect evidence, but they may not be the action being certified.
For every capability define the actual user-visible postcondition. Execute the real command, collect fresh evidence, and let Argus evaluate that postcondition. If it fails, automatically preserve the original GoalRun, continue/create the appropriate AntiGravity repair, diagnose the shared root cause, edit the repository, test, build, deploy, reload/restart as necessary, retry the EXACT original production command, and verify again. Keep doing this until PASS or a genuine external blocker. I should not have to participate.
Start with this certification registry: Word blank-document creation; screenshot capture and retrieval; Windows Settings; Telegram; Adobe Acrobat; Comet Perplexity; Hermes 1 opening and fresh UI perception; webcam opening and fresh visual perception; conversational camera questions; Zeus authoritative American live TTS; TTS completion without clipped final words; voice latency; browser navigation; YouTube/channel navigation; application discovery from desktop/start menu/taskbar; compound commands; foreground-window control; file creation/read/write; and engineering delegation to AntiGravity. Include any other AgenticOS capabilities registered in the runtime automatically.
Use strict acceptance contracts. Screenshot PASS requires a newly created PNG tied to that GoalRun, exact filesystem path, existence, nonzero size, hash, and Jarvis must be able to tell me or show me where it was saved. Never answer only with a byte count.
Application-open PASS requires the correct application window/HWND to exist and be foregrounded when foregrounding was requested. A process merely running in the background is not PASS.
Browser PASS requires the requested destination to be loaded and the active URL/page verified, not merely a browser process.
Hermes perception PASS requires a fresh UI Automation/perception snapshot taken after the current request and content from the requested window, not cached text.
Camera PASS has two levels. Hardware capture PASS requires a fresh frame, timestamp, dimensions, artifact path and hash. Conversational vision PASS requires a fresh frame captured for THAT SAME USER TURN and actual visual analysis of that frame. If no fresh frame is available, Jarvis must explicitly say it cannot see the scene. It is forbidden to claim “I can see you” or describe what I am doing without same-turn visual evidence. Questions such as “What am I holding?” must trigger a new capture and vision inference, never a canned presence response.
Zeus PASS requires the actual live Jarvis TTS path to use aura-zeus-en and the NEXT NORMAL JARVIS RESPONSE to be synthesized through it. Producing a separate test audio file is not acceptance.
Most importantly, remove verification self-certification. AntiGravity, campaign runners, helper scripts and background-task code must not directly set verified, completed, allPassed=true, or equivalent certification state. A worker may only submit evidence. Only the authoritative supervisor/completion controller may transition a GoalRun or capability to VERIFIED/PASS after independent Argus evidence from the post-repair retry of the original command. Audit the codebase for every bypass and remove it.
Add a freshness requirement to evidence: evidence must be generated after the current test began and correlated to the same GoalRun/test execution. Old processes, old screenshots, old camera frames or previous successful executions may not satisfy a new test.
Run only one repair at a time. If AntiGravity stalls, resume the SAME task. After each repair, rerun the failed capability before moving on. Do not stop because compilation or unit tests pass.
Continue unattended until every capability is either VERIFIED PASS or TRUE EXTERNAL BLOCKER. At completion, persist a capability matrix containing capability, exact production command, GoalRun, PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED, failure observed, AntiGravity task ID, root cause, files changed, build/deploy evidence, retry timestamp, fresh Argus evidence, and final postcondition.
Also schedule this certification runner for startup and allow me later to request “run full system certification” so Jarvis can periodically detect regressions and self-heal them without me manually checking everything.
Do not tell me everything is healthy until this production-path certification completes. Start now and continue autonomously.

Relevant Context:
Requested over the JARVIS live conversation channel.
